launches.title: SynthioLabs: World's First AI Medical Expert for Pharma GTM Teams
launches.tagline: We scale your physician engagement - zero headcount added
launches.body:
👋 Hey everyone,

We’re [Supreet](https://www.linkedin.com/in/supreetdeshpande/), [Raj](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajashekar-v/) and [Sahitya](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sahitya-sridhar/) - the team behind [SynthioLabs](https://www.synthiolabs.com/), and we’re building the **world’s first AI Medical Expert for Pharma GTM teams**.

**Our Vision:** Reimagine how pharma engages with its most important stakeholders - physicians and patients

**TL;DR**

💡 Our always-on **_AI medical expert_** delivers **_compliant, accurate, and science-first engagement_** to every physician.

We help pharma GTM teams **3x their physician reach** while ensuring every interaction is medically accurate and personalized.

**🎥 See us in action:**

<https://youtu.be/OoJA5R0y9EQ>

**🚨 Why now?**

Pharma’s current model is falling short - despite extensive sales teams, most doctors remain unengaged by pharma

→ **7 out of 10 oncologists** report no meaningful touchpoints with pharma

→ **Long-tail physicians (50–60%)** often receive little to no engagement from pharma reps

→ Many physicians express a **need for deeper scientific insight and relevant medical knowledge**, rather than generic promotional outreach

With SynthioLabs, you can engage every physician, not just the top tier. No sales reps? No problem, we scale your team instantly.

**🧠 What SynthioLabs does:**

✅ Identifies and screens physicians

✅ Engages in compliant, medical discussions

✅ Educates on clinical guidelines and evidence

✅ Books follow-ups with your medical and sales teams

**📡 The Synthio Polaris Platform for Physician Engagement**

We’re building more than just one agent. Our platform lets you design intelligent AI agents — medical experts, nurse educators, field partners to **_transform how you engage physicians_**.

**👥 About us**

We’re ex-McKinsey, ex-ZS, and AI researchers from Amazon.

We’ve worked with 10 of the top 20 pharma companies and bring over a decade of experience in life sciences, strategy, and AI.

🔍 Want to see it in action?

→ Visit [synthiolabs.com](http://synthiolabs.com)

→ DM us or drop your email to book a demo

→ Know someone in a life science commercial or marketing team? Share this post with them **🙏**

🧠🤝 **Lets redefine how pharma connects with physicians!**

— Supreet, Sahitya and Raj
